# ============================================================
# RANDOM SEED SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS
# Proposed model: PeepholeMN-RFR
# Target: TemperatureAnomaly_C
# Seeds: 7, 14, 21, 35, 42, 56, 63, 77, 84, 99
# ============================================================

import os
import time
import random
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, TensorDataset

from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import (
    r2_score,
    mean_squared_error,
    mean_absolute_error
)

# ============================================================
# 1. CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================

DATA_DIR = r"C:\Users\S3\Downloads\Step3_Preprocessing_Results"

OUTPUT_DIR = r"C:\Users\S3\Downloads\Step9_RandomSeed_Analysis"

os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

TARGET = "TemperatureAnomaly_C"

SEEDS = [7, 14, 21, 35, 42, 56, 63, 77, 84, 99]

DEVICE = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

# Model parameters (fixed across all seeds)
HIDDEN_UNITS = 64
LEARNING_RATE = 0.001
BATCH_SIZE = 32
MAX_EPOCHS = 150
PATIENCE = 20
DROPOUT = 0.20
RF_TREES = 300

print("Execution Device:", DEVICE)
print("Target:", TARGET)
print("Seeds:", SEEDS)


# ============================================================
# 2. LOAD PREPROCESSED DATA
# ============================================================

train_df = pd.read_csv(
    os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "Training_Preprocessed.csv")
)

val_df = pd.read_csv(
    os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "Validation_Preprocessed.csv")
)

test_df = pd.read_csv(
    os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "Testing_Preprocessed.csv")
)

# Separate features and target
feature_cols = [c for c in train_df.columns if c not in
                ["TemperatureAnomaly_C", "EnergyLoad_MW"]]

X_train = train_df[feature_cols].values.astype(np.float32)
X_val = val_df[feature_cols].values.astype(np.float32)
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].values.astype(np.float32)

y_train = train_df[TARGET].values.astype(np.float32)
y_val = val_df[TARGET].values.astype(np.float32)
y_test = test_df[TARGET].values.astype(np.float32)

print("\nDataset Loaded Successfully")
print("Training:", X_train.shape)
print("Validation:", X_val.shape)
print("Testing:", X_test.shape)
print("Features:", feature_cols)


# ============================================================
# 3. RANDOM SEED FUNCTION
# ============================================================

def set_seed(seed):

    random.seed(seed)
    np.random.seed(seed)

    torch.manual_seed(seed)

    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        torch.cuda.manual_seed(seed)
        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)

    torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic = True
    torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = False


# ============================================================
# 4. PEEPHOLE LSTM ENCODER
# ============================================================

class PeepholeLSTMEncoder(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, input_size, hidden_size, dropout=0.20):

        super().__init__()

        self.hidden_size = hidden_size

        # Input, forget, output, and candidate gates
        self.W_x = nn.Linear(input_size, 4 * hidden_size)

        self.W_h = nn.Linear(hidden_size, 4 * hidden_size,
                            bias=False)

        # Peephole connections
        self.W_ci = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(hidden_size))
        self.W_cf = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(hidden_size))
        self.W_co = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(hidden_size))

        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)

    def forward(self, x):

        batch_size, seq_len, _ = x.size()

        h = torch.zeros(
            batch_size, self.hidden_size, device=x.device
        )

        c = torch.zeros(
            batch_size, self.hidden_size, device=x.device
        )

        for t in range(seq_len):

            xt = x[:, t, :]

            gates = self.W_x(xt) + self.W_h(h)

            i_gate, f_gate, g_gate, o_gate = gates.chunk(4, dim=1)

            i_gate = torch.sigmoid(
                i_gate + self.W_ci * c
            )

            f_gate = torch.sigmoid(
                f_gate + self.W_cf * c
            )

            g_gate = torch.tanh(g_gate)

            c = f_gate * c + i_gate * g_gate

            o_gate = torch.sigmoid(
                o_gate + self.W_co * c
            )

            h = o_gate * torch.tanh(c)

            h = self.dropout(h)

        return h


# ============================================================
# 5. TRAIN PEEPHOLE LSTM
# ============================================================

def train_encoder(seed):

    set_seed(seed)

    # Feature vector treated as a sequence of feature positions
    Xtr = torch.tensor(X_train).unsqueeze(-1)
    Xv = torch.tensor(X_val).unsqueeze(-1)

    ytr = torch.tensor(y_train).reshape(-1, 1)
    yv = torch.tensor(y_val).reshape(-1, 1)

    train_loader = DataLoader(
        TensorDataset(Xtr, ytr),
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=True
    )

    model = PeepholeLSTMEncoder(
        input_size=1,
        hidden_size=HIDDEN_UNITS,
        dropout=DROPOUT
    ).to(DEVICE)

    regression_head = nn.Linear(
        HIDDEN_UNITS, 1
    ).to(DEVICE)

    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(
        list(model.parameters()) +
        list(regression_head.parameters()),
        lr=LEARNING_RATE
    )

    criterion = nn.MSELoss()

    best_val_loss = float("inf")
    best_model_state = None
    best_head_state = None

    patience_counter = 0

    for epoch in range(MAX_EPOCHS):

        model.train()
        regression_head.train()

        for xb, yb in train_loader:

            xb = xb.to(DEVICE)
            yb = yb.to(DEVICE)

            optimizer.zero_grad()

            embedding = model(xb)

            pred = regression_head(embedding)

            loss = criterion(pred, yb)

            loss.backward()

            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(
                list(model.parameters()) +
                list(regression_head.parameters()),
                max_norm=1.0
            )

            optimizer.step()

        # Validation
        model.eval()
        regression_head.eval()

        with torch.no_grad():

            val_embeddings = model(Xv.to(DEVICE))

            val_predictions = regression_head(val_embeddings)

            val_loss = criterion(
                val_predictions,
                yv.to(DEVICE)
            ).item()

        if val_loss < best_val_loss:

            best_val_loss = val_loss

            best_model_state = {
                k: v.detach().cpu().clone()
                for k, v in model.state_dict().items()
            }

            best_head_state = {
                k: v.detach().cpu().clone()
                for k, v in regression_head.state_dict().items()
            }

            patience_counter = 0

        else:

            patience_counter += 1

        if patience_counter >= PATIENCE:
            break

    # Restore best validation model
    model.load_state_dict(best_model_state)
    regression_head.load_state_dict(best_head_state)

    model.eval()

    return model


# ============================================================
# 6. EXTRACT LSTM EMBEDDINGS
# ============================================================

def extract_embeddings(model, X):

    X_tensor = torch.tensor(X).unsqueeze(-1)

    model.eval()

    embeddings = []

    with torch.no_grad():

        for i in range(0, len(X_tensor), BATCH_SIZE):

            xb = X_tensor[i:i + BATCH_SIZE].to(DEVICE)

            emb = model(xb)

            embeddings.append(
                emb.cpu().numpy()
            )

    return np.concatenate(embeddings, axis=0)


# ============================================================
# 7. METRIC CALCULATION
# ============================================================

def calculate_metrics(y_true, y_pred):

    mse = mean_squared_error(y_true, y_pred)

    rmse = np.sqrt(mse)

    mae = mean_absolute_error(y_true, y_pred)

    r2 = r2_score(y_true, y_pred)

    # RSR = RMSE / Standard deviation of observed values
    std_observed = np.std(y_true, ddof=1)

    rsr = rmse / std_observed if std_observed != 0 else np.nan

    # Nash-Sutcliffe Efficiency
    denominator = np.sum(
        (y_true - np.mean(y_true)) ** 2
    )

    nse = (
        1 - np.sum((y_true - y_pred) ** 2) / denominator
        if denominator != 0 else np.nan
    )

    return {
        "R²": r2,
        "RSR": rsr,
        "NSE": nse,
        "MAE": mae,
        "RMSE": rmse,
        "MSE": mse
    }


# ============================================================
# 8. RUN RANDOM SEED EXPERIMENTS
# ============================================================

results = []

for seed in SEEDS:

    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print(f"Running Random Seed: {seed}")
    print("=" * 60)

    total_start = time.time()

    set_seed(seed)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Train Peephole LSTM
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    lstm_start = time.time()

    encoder = train_encoder(seed)

    lstm_time = time.time() - lstm_start

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Embedding extraction
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    embedding_start = time.time()

    train_embeddings = extract_embeddings(
        encoder, X_train
    )

    val_embeddings = extract_embeddings(
        encoder, X_val
    )

    test_embeddings = extract_embeddings(
        encoder, X_test
    )

    embedding_time = time.time() - embedding_start

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Random Forest Regression
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    rf_start = time.time()

    rf_model = RandomForestRegressor(
        n_estimators=RF_TREES,
        random_state=seed,
        n_jobs=-1
    )

    rf_model.fit(
        train_embeddings,
        y_train
    )

    rf_training_time = time.time() - rf_start

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Testing
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    prediction_start = time.time()

    y_pred = rf_model.predict(test_embeddings)

    prediction_time = time.time() - prediction_start

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Metrics
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    metrics = calculate_metrics(
        y_test, y_pred
    )

    total_time = time.time() - total_start

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Store results
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    result = {
        "Random Seed": seed,
        **metrics,
        "Computation Time (s)": total_time,
        "LSTM Training Time (s)": lstm_time,
        "Embedding Extraction Time (s)": embedding_time,
        "RF Training Time (s)": rf_training_time,
        "Prediction Time (s)": prediction_time
    }

    results.append(result)

    print("R²:", round(metrics["R²"], 6))
    print("RSR:", round(metrics["RSR"], 6))
    print("NSE:", round(metrics["NSE"], 6))
    print("MAE:", round(metrics["MAE"], 6))
    print("RMSE:", round(metrics["RMSE"], 6))
    print("MSE:", round(metrics["MSE"], 6))
    print("Computation Time:", round(total_time, 4), "seconds")


# ============================================================
# 9. RESULTS TABLE
# ============================================================

results_df = pd.DataFrame(results)

# Mark seed 42 as the predefined reference/optimal seed
results_df["Status"] = np.where(
    results_df["Random Seed"] == 42,
    "Optimal / Reference",
    ""
)

results_df = results_df[
    [
        "Random Seed",
        "R²",
        "RSR",
        "NSE",
        "MAE",
        "RMSE",
        "MSE",
        "Computation Time (s)",
        "Status"
    ]
]

# Round metrics
numeric_cols = results_df.select_dtypes(
    include=[np.number]
).columns

results_df[numeric_cols] = results_df[numeric_cols].round(6)

print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("RANDOM SEED SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS RESULTS")
print("=" * 80)

print(results_df.to_string(index=False))


# ============================================================
# 10. SAVE RESULTS
# ============================================================

output_csv = os.path.join(
    OUTPUT_DIR,
    "Random_Seed_Sensitivity_Analysis.csv"
)

results_df.to_csv(
    output_csv,
    index=False
)

print("\nResults saved to:")
print(output_csv)


# ============================================================
# 11. SUMMARY STATISTICS
# ============================================================

summary_df = results_df.drop(
    columns=["Random Seed", "Status"]
).agg(["mean", "std", "min", "max"])

summary_path = os.path.join(
    OUTPUT_DIR,
    "Random_Seed_Summary_Statistics.csv"
)

summary_df.to_csv(summary_path)

print("\nSummary Statistics:")
print(summary_df.round(6))

# ==============================================================
# 5-FOLD CROSS-VALIDATION
# Model: PeepholeMN-RFR
# Target: TemperatureAnomaly_C
# Metrics: R2, RSR, NSE, MAE, RMSE, MSE
# ==============================================================

import os
import time
import random
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, TensorDataset

from sklearn.model_selection import KFold, train_test_split
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import (
    r2_score,
    mean_squared_error,
    mean_absolute_error
)

# ==============================================================
# 1. CONFIGURATION
# ==============================================================

DATA_DIR = r"C:\Users\S3\Downloads\Step3_Preprocessing_Results"

OUTPUT_DIR = r"C:\Users\S3\Downloads\Step10_5Fold_CV"

os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

TARGET = "TemperatureAnomaly_C"

SEED = 42
N_FOLDS = 5

DEVICE = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

# Fixed model hyperparameters
HIDDEN_UNITS = 64
LEARNING_RATE = 0.001
BATCH_SIZE = 32
MAX_EPOCHS = 150
PATIENCE = 20
DROPOUT = 0.20
RF_TREES = 300

print("Device:", DEVICE)
print("Target:", TARGET)
print("Cross-validation folds:", N_FOLDS)


# ==============================================================
# 2. RANDOM SEED
# ==============================================================

def set_seed(seed):

    random.seed(seed)
    np.random.seed(seed)
    torch.manual_seed(seed)

    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        torch.cuda.manual_seed(seed)
        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)

    torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic = True
    torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = False


set_seed(SEED)


# ==============================================================
# 3. LOAD TRAINING DATA
# ==============================================================

train_df = pd.read_csv(
    os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "Training_Preprocessed.csv")
)

feature_cols = [
    c for c in train_df.columns
    if c not in ["TemperatureAnomaly_C", "EnergyLoad_MW"]
]

X = train_df[feature_cols].values.astype(np.float32)
y = train_df[TARGET].values.astype(np.float32)

print("\nDataset shape:", X.shape)
print("Target shape:", y.shape)
print("Features:", feature_cols)


# ==============================================================
# 4. PEEPHOLE LSTM ENCODER
# ==============================================================

class PeepholeLSTMEncoder(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, input_size, hidden_size, dropout=0.20):

        super().__init__()

        self.hidden_size = hidden_size

        self.W_x = nn.Linear(input_size, 4 * hidden_size)
        self.W_h = nn.Linear(hidden_size, 4 * hidden_size, bias=False)

        self.W_ci = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(hidden_size))
        self.W_cf = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(hidden_size))
        self.W_co = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(hidden_size))

        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)

    def forward(self, x):

        batch_size, seq_len, _ = x.size()

        h = torch.zeros(
            batch_size, self.hidden_size, device=x.device
        )

        c = torch.zeros(
            batch_size, self.hidden_size, device=x.device
        )

        for t in range(seq_len):

            xt = x[:, t, :]

            gates = self.W_x(xt) + self.W_h(h)

            i_gate, f_gate, g_gate, o_gate = gates.chunk(4, dim=1)

            i_gate = torch.sigmoid(i_gate + self.W_ci * c)
            f_gate = torch.sigmoid(f_gate + self.W_cf * c)
            g_gate = torch.tanh(g_gate)

            c = f_gate * c + i_gate * g_gate

            o_gate = torch.sigmoid(o_gate + self.W_co * c)

            h = o_gate * torch.tanh(c)

            h = self.dropout(h)

        return h


# ==============================================================
# 5. TRAIN ENCODER WITH INTERNAL VALIDATION
# ==============================================================

def train_encoder(X_fold_train, y_fold_train,
                 X_internal_val, y_internal_val, seed):

    set_seed(seed)

    # Features treated as sequence positions
    Xtr_tensor = torch.tensor(
        X_fold_train, dtype=torch.float32
    ).unsqueeze(-1)

    Xval_tensor = torch.tensor(
        X_internal_val, dtype=torch.float32
    ).unsqueeze(-1)

    ytr_tensor = torch.tensor(
        y_fold_train, dtype=torch.float32
    ).reshape(-1, 1)

    yval_tensor = torch.tensor(
        y_internal_val, dtype=torch.float32
    ).reshape(-1, 1)

    train_loader = DataLoader(
        TensorDataset(Xtr_tensor, ytr_tensor),
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=True
    )

    encoder = PeepholeLSTMEncoder(
        input_size=1,
        hidden_size=HIDDEN_UNITS,
        dropout=DROPOUT
    ).to(DEVICE)

    regressor = nn.Linear(
        HIDDEN_UNITS, 1
    ).to(DEVICE)

    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(
        list(encoder.parameters()) +
        list(regressor.parameters()),
        lr=LEARNING_RATE
    )

    criterion = nn.MSELoss()

    best_val_loss = float("inf")
    best_encoder_state = None
    best_regressor_state = None
    patience_counter = 0

    for epoch in range(MAX_EPOCHS):

        encoder.train()
        regressor.train()

        for xb, yb in train_loader:

            xb = xb.to(DEVICE)
            yb = yb.to(DEVICE)

            optimizer.zero_grad()

            embedding = encoder(xb)
            prediction = regressor(embedding)

            loss = criterion(prediction, yb)

            loss.backward()

            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(
                list(encoder.parameters()) +
                list(regressor.parameters()),
                max_norm=1.0
            )

            optimizer.step()

        # Internal validation
        encoder.eval()
        regressor.eval()

        with torch.no_grad():

            val_embedding = encoder(
                Xval_tensor.to(DEVICE)
            )

            val_prediction = regressor(val_embedding)

            val_loss = criterion(
                val_prediction,
                yval_tensor.to(DEVICE)
            ).item()

        # Early stopping
        if val_loss < best_val_loss:

            best_val_loss = val_loss

            best_encoder_state = {
                k: v.detach().cpu().clone()
                for k, v in encoder.state_dict().items()
            }

            best_regressor_state = {
                k: v.detach().cpu().clone()
                for k, v in regressor.state_dict().items()
            }

            patience_counter = 0

        else:

            patience_counter += 1

        if patience_counter >= PATIENCE:
            break

    encoder.load_state_dict(best_encoder_state)
    regressor.load_state_dict(best_regressor_state)

    encoder.eval()

    return encoder


# ==============================================================
# 6. EMBEDDING EXTRACTION
# ==============================================================

def extract_embeddings(encoder, X_data):

    X_tensor = torch.tensor(
        X_data, dtype=torch.float32
    ).unsqueeze(-1)

    embeddings = []

    encoder.eval()

    with torch.no_grad():

        for start in range(0, len(X_tensor), BATCH_SIZE):

            xb = X_tensor[start:start + BATCH_SIZE].to(DEVICE)

            emb = encoder(xb)

            embeddings.append(emb.cpu().numpy())

    return np.concatenate(embeddings, axis=0)


# ==============================================================
# 7. METRICS
# ==============================================================

def calculate_metrics(y_true, y_pred):

    mse = mean_squared_error(y_true, y_pred)
    rmse = np.sqrt(mse)
    mae = mean_absolute_error(y_true, y_pred)
    r2 = r2_score(y_true, y_pred)

    # RSR
    std_observed = np.std(y_true, ddof=1)

    rsr = (
        rmse / std_observed
        if std_observed != 0 else np.nan
    )

    # NSE
    denominator = np.sum(
        (y_true - np.mean(y_true)) ** 2
    )

    nse = (
        1 - np.sum((y_true - y_pred) ** 2) / denominator
        if denominator != 0 else np.nan
    )

    return {
        "R²": r2,
        "RSR": rsr,
        "NSE": nse,
        "MAE": mae,
        "RMSE": rmse,
        "MSE": mse
    }


# ==============================================================
# 8. FIVE-FOLD CROSS-VALIDATION
# ==============================================================

kf = KFold(
    n_splits=N_FOLDS,
    shuffle=True,
    random_state=SEED
)

fold_results = []

for fold, (train_idx, test_idx) in enumerate(
    kf.split(X), start=1
):

    print("\n" + "=" * 65)
    print(f"FOLD {fold}/{N_FOLDS}")
    print("=" * 65)

    fold_start = time.time()

    # Outer fold split
    X_fold_train = X[train_idx]
    y_fold_train = y[train_idx]

    X_fold_test = X[test_idx]
    y_fold_test = y[test_idx]

    # Internal validation split for early stopping
    X_subtrain, X_internal_val, y_subtrain, y_internal_val = \
        train_test_split(
            X_fold_train,
            y_fold_train,
            test_size=0.15,
            random_state=SEED + fold
        )

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Train Peephole LSTM
    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    encoder_start = time.time()

    encoder = train_encoder(
        X_subtrain,
        y_subtrain,
        X_internal_val,
        y_internal_val,
        seed=SEED + fold
    )

    encoder_training_time = time.time() - encoder_start

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Extract embeddings
    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    embedding_start = time.time()

    train_embeddings = extract_embeddings(
        encoder, X_subtrain
    )

    test_embeddings = extract_embeddings(
        encoder, X_fold_test
    )

    embedding_time = time.time() - embedding_start

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Train Random Forest
    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    rf_start = time.time()

    rf_model = RandomForestRegressor(
        n_estimators=RF_TREES,
        random_state=SEED + fold,
        n_jobs=-1
    )

    rf_model.fit(
        train_embeddings,
        y_subtrain
    )

    rf_training_time = time.time() - rf_start

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Prediction
    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    prediction_start = time.time()

    y_pred = rf_model.predict(test_embeddings)

    prediction_time = time.time() - prediction_start

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Metrics
    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    metrics = calculate_metrics(
        y_fold_test, y_pred
    )

    total_fold_time = time.time() - fold_start

    fold_result = {
        "Folds": f"Fold-{fold}",
        **metrics
    }

    fold_results.append(fold_result)

    print("R²:", round(metrics["R²"], 6))
    print("RSR:", round(metrics["RSR"], 6))
    print("NSE:", round(metrics["NSE"], 6))
    print("MAE:", round(metrics["MAE"], 6))
    print("RMSE:", round(metrics["RMSE"], 6))
    print("MSE:", round(metrics["MSE"], 6))
    print("Total fold time:", round(total_fold_time, 4), "s")


# ==============================================================
# 9. CREATE FOLD-WISE RESULTS TABLE
# ==============================================================

fold_df = pd.DataFrame(fold_results)

# Average across the five folds
avg_row = {
    "Folds": "Avg"
}

metric_columns = [
    "R²", "RSR", "NSE", "MAE", "RMSE", "MSE"
]

for metric in metric_columns:
    avg_row[metric] = fold_df[metric].mean()

final_df = pd.concat(
    [fold_df, pd.DataFrame([avg_row])],
    ignore_index=True
)

final_df[metric_columns] = final_df[metric_columns].round(6)

print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("5-FOLD CROSS-VALIDATION RESULTS")
print("=" * 80)

print(final_df.to_string(index=False))


# ==============================================================
# 10. SAVE CSV RESULTS
# ==============================================================

output_file = os.path.join(
    OUTPUT_DIR,
    "PeepholeMN_RFR_5Fold_CV_Results.csv"
)

final_df.to_csv(
    output_file,
    index=False
)

print("\nResults saved successfully:")
print(output_file)

# ============================================================
# ABLATION STUDY: PeepholeMN-RFR
# Target: TemperatureAnomaly_C
# Seed: 42
# Metrics: R2, RSR, NSE, MAE, RMSE, MSE
# ============================================================

import os
import time
import random
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, TensorDataset

from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import (
    r2_score,
    mean_squared_error,
    mean_absolute_error
)

# ============================================================
# 1. CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================

DATA_DIR = r"C:\Users\S3\Downloads\Step3_Preprocessing_Results"

OUTPUT_DIR = r"C:\Users\S3\Downloads\Step11_Ablation_Study"

os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

TARGET = "TemperatureAnomaly_C"
SEED = 42

DEVICE = torch.device(
    "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
)

HIDDEN_UNITS = 64
BATCH_SIZE = 32
EPOCHS = 120
LEARNING_RATE = 0.001
PATIENCE = 15
DROPOUT = 0.20

RF_TREES = 300

print("Device:", DEVICE)
print("Target:", TARGET)


# ============================================================
# 2. SEED
# ============================================================

def set_seed(seed=42):

    random.seed(seed)
    np.random.seed(seed)
    torch.manual_seed(seed)

    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)

    torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic = True
    torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = False


set_seed(SEED)


# ============================================================
# 3. LOAD DATA
# ==============================================================

train_df = pd.read_csv(
    os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "Training_Preprocessed.csv")
)

val_df = pd.read_csv(
    os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "Validation_Preprocessed.csv")
)

test_df = pd.read_csv(
    os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "Testing_Preprocessed.csv")
)

feature_cols = [
    c for c in train_df.columns
    if c not in ["TemperatureAnomaly_C", "EnergyLoad_MW"]
]

X_train = train_df[feature_cols].values.astype(np.float32)
X_val = val_df[feature_cols].values.astype(np.float32)
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].values.astype(np.float32)

y_train = train_df[TARGET].values.astype(np.float32)
y_val = val_df[TARGET].values.astype(np.float32)
y_test = test_df[TARGET].values.astype(np.float32)

print("Train:", X_train.shape)
print("Validation:", X_val.shape)
print("Test:", X_test.shape)


# ============================================================
# 4. STANDARD LSTM ENCODER
# ==============================================================

class StandardLSTMEncoder(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, input_size=1, hidden_size=64, dropout=0.2):

        super().__init__()

        self.lstm = nn.LSTM(
            input_size=input_size,
            hidden_size=hidden_size,
            num_layers=2,
            batch_first=True,
            dropout=dropout
        )

    def forward(self, x):

        _, (h, _) = self.lstm(x)

        return h[-1]


# ============================================================
# 5. PEEPHOLE LSTM ENCODER
# ==============================================================

class PeepholeLSTMEncoder(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, input_size=1, hidden_size=64, dropout=0.2):

        super().__init__()

        self.hidden_size = hidden_size

        self.W_x = nn.Linear(input_size, 4 * hidden_size)
        self.W_h = nn.Linear(hidden_size, 4 * hidden_size, bias=False)

        self.W_ci = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(hidden_size))
        self.W_cf = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(hidden_size))
        self.W_co = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(hidden_size))

        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)

    def forward(self, x):

        batch_size, seq_len, _ = x.size()

        h = torch.zeros(
            batch_size, self.hidden_size, device=x.device
        )

        c = torch.zeros(
            batch_size, self.hidden_size, device=x.device
        )

        for t in range(seq_len):

            gates = self.W_x(x[:, t, :]) + self.W_h(h)

            i, f, g, o = gates.chunk(4, dim=1)

            i = torch.sigmoid(i + self.W_ci * c)
            f = torch.sigmoid(f + self.W_cf * c)
            g = torch.tanh(g)

            c = f * c + i * g

            o = torch.sigmoid(o + self.W_co * c)

            h = o * torch.tanh(c)

            h = self.dropout(h)

        return h


# ============================================================
# 6. PO ENHANCED LSTM
#    Standard LSTM + learned peephole optimization gates
# ==============================================================

class POEnhancedLSTMEncoder(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, input_size=1, hidden_size=64, dropout=0.2):

        super().__init__()

        self.hidden_size = hidden_size

        self.lstm = nn.LSTM(
            input_size=input_size,
            hidden_size=hidden_size,
            num_layers=2,
            batch_first=True,
            dropout=dropout
        )

        # Peephole optimization enhancement
        self.input_optimization = nn.Linear(
            input_size, hidden_size
        )

        self.hidden_optimization = nn.Linear(
            hidden_size, hidden_size
        )

        self.optimization_gate = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size, hidden_size),
            nn.Sigmoid()
        )

        self.refinement = nn.Linear(
            hidden_size, hidden_size
        )

    def forward(self, x):

        _, (h, _) = self.lstm(x)

        base_embedding = h[-1]

        # Input-dependent optimization signal
        input_signal = torch.mean(
            self.input_optimization(x), dim=1
        )

        optimization_signal = (
            input_signal +
            self.hidden_optimization(base_embedding)
        )

        gate = self.optimization_gate(
            optimization_signal
        )

        optimized_embedding = (
            base_embedding +
            gate * torch.tanh(
                self.refinement(optimization_signal)
            )
        )

        return optimized_embedding


# ============================================================
# 7. TRAIN NEURAL ENCODER
# ==============================================================

def train_neural_encoder(
    encoder,
    Xtr,
    ytr,
    Xv,
    yv
):

    set_seed(SEED)

    Xtr_tensor = torch.tensor(Xtr).unsqueeze(-1)
    Xv_tensor = torch.tensor(Xv).unsqueeze(-1)

    ytr_tensor = torch.tensor(ytr).reshape(-1, 1)
    yv_tensor = torch.tensor(yv).reshape(-1, 1)

    train_loader = DataLoader(
        TensorDataset(Xtr_tensor, ytr_tensor),
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=True
    )

    encoder = encoder.to(DEVICE)

    head = nn.Linear(
        HIDDEN_UNITS, 1
    ).to(DEVICE)

    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(
        list(encoder.parameters()) +
        list(head.parameters()),
        lr=LEARNING_RATE
    )

    criterion = nn.MSELoss()

    best_loss = float("inf")
    best_encoder = None
    best_head = None
    counter = 0

    for epoch in range(EPOCHS):

        encoder.train()
        head.train()

        for xb, yb in train_loader:

            xb = xb.to(DEVICE)
            yb = yb.to(DEVICE)

            optimizer.zero_grad()

            embedding = encoder(xb)
            pred = head(embedding)

            loss = criterion(pred, yb)

            loss.backward()

            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(
                list(encoder.parameters()) +
                list(head.parameters()),
                1.0
            )

            optimizer.step()

        # Validation
        encoder.eval()
        head.eval()

        with torch.no_grad():

            val_emb = encoder(Xv_tensor.to(DEVICE))
            val_pred = head(val_emb)

            val_loss = criterion(
                val_pred,
                yv_tensor.to(DEVICE)
            ).item()

        if val_loss < best_loss:

            best_loss = val_loss

            best_encoder = {
                k: v.detach().cpu().clone()
                for k, v in encoder.state_dict().items()
            }

            best_head = {
                k: v.detach().cpu().clone()
                for k, v in head.state_dict().items()
            }

            counter = 0

        else:

            counter += 1

        if counter >= PATIENCE:
            break

    encoder.load_state_dict(best_encoder)
    head.load_state_dict(best_head)

    encoder.eval()

    return encoder


# ============================================================
# 8. EMBEDDING EXTRACTION
# ==============================================================

def extract_embeddings(encoder, X):

    X_tensor = torch.tensor(X).unsqueeze(-1)

    embeddings = []

    encoder.eval()

    with torch.no_grad():

        for i in range(0, len(X_tensor), BATCH_SIZE):

            xb = X_tensor[i:i+BATCH_SIZE].to(DEVICE)

            emb = encoder(xb)

            embeddings.append(
                emb.cpu().numpy()
            )

    return np.concatenate(embeddings, axis=0)


# ============================================================
# 9. METRICS
# ==============================================================

def calculate_metrics(y_true, y_pred):

    mse = mean_squared_error(y_true, y_pred)
    rmse = np.sqrt(mse)
    mae = mean_absolute_error(y_true, y_pred)
    r2 = r2_score(y_true, y_pred)

    std_obs = np.std(y_true, ddof=1)

    rsr = (
        rmse / std_obs
        if std_obs != 0 else np.nan
    )

    denominator = np.sum(
        (y_true - np.mean(y_true)) ** 2
    )

    nse = (
        1 - np.sum((y_true - y_pred) ** 2) / denominator
        if denominator != 0 else np.nan
    )

    return {
        "R²": r2,
        "RSR": rsr,
        "NSE": nse,
        "MAE": mae,
        "RMSE": rmse,
        "MSE": mse
    }


# ============================================================
# 10. EVALUATE RFR
# ==============================================================

def evaluate_rfr(Xtr, ytr, Xte, seed=42):

    start = time.time()

    model = RandomForestRegressor(
        n_estimators=RF_TREES,
        random_state=seed,
        n_jobs=-1
    )

    model.fit(Xtr, ytr)

    prediction = model.predict(Xte)

    elapsed = time.time() - start

    metrics = calculate_metrics(y_test, prediction)

    return metrics, elapsed


# ============================================================
# 11. EVALUATE NEURAL MODEL
# ==============================================================

def evaluate_neural(encoder_class, use_rfr=False):

    total_start = time.time()

    encoder = encoder_class(
        input_size=1,
        hidden_size=HIDDEN_UNITS,
        dropout=DROPOUT
    )

    trained_encoder = train_neural_encoder(
        encoder,
        X_train,
        y_train,
        X_val,
        y_val
    )

    train_embeddings = extract_embeddings(
        trained_encoder, X_train
    )

    test_embeddings = extract_embeddings(
        trained_encoder, X_test
    )

    if use_rfr:

        rfr = RandomForestRegressor(
            n_estimators=RF_TREES,
            random_state=SEED,
            n_jobs=-1
        )

        rfr.fit(train_embeddings, y_train)

        prediction = rfr.predict(test_embeddings)

    else:

        # Train direct regression head on embeddings
        # (retrain regression head using extracted features)
        regressor = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(HIDDEN_UNITS, 32),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(32, 1)
        ).to(DEVICE)

        optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(
            regressor.parameters(),
            lr=LEARNING_RATE
        )

        criterion = nn.MSELoss()

        Xt = torch.tensor(
            train_embeddings, dtype=torch.float32
        )

        yt = torch.tensor(
            y_train, dtype=torch.float32
        ).reshape(-1, 1)

        loader = DataLoader(
            TensorDataset(Xt, yt),
            batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
            shuffle=True
        )

        for epoch in range(60):

            regressor.train()

            for xb, yb in loader:

                xb = xb.to(DEVICE)
                yb = yb.to(DEVICE)

                optimizer.zero_grad()

                pred = regressor(xb)

                loss = criterion(pred, yb)

                loss.backward()
                optimizer.step()

        regressor.eval()

        with torch.no_grad():

            prediction = regressor(
                torch.tensor(
                    test_embeddings,
                    dtype=torch.float32
                ).to(DEVICE)
            ).cpu().numpy().flatten()

    metrics = calculate_metrics(
        y_test, prediction
    )

    elapsed = time.time() - total_start

    return metrics, elapsed


# ============================================================
# 12. RUN ABLATION EXPERIMENTS
# ==============================================================

results = []

# ============================================================
# PAIRED STATISTICAL SIGNIFICANCE TEST
# Peephole LSTM vs PeepholeMN-RFR (Proposed)
# 5-Fold Cross Validation
# Target: TemperatureAnomaly_C
# ==============================================================

import os
import time
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from scipy.stats import ttest_rel, t

from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import (
    r2_score,
    mean_squared_error,
    mean_absolute_error
)

# ============================================================
# 1. CONFIGURATION
# ==============================================================

OUTPUT_DIR = r"C:\Users\S3\Downloads\Step12_Paired_Statistical_Test"

os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

SEED = 42
N_FOLDS = 5

METRICS = ["R²", "RSR", "NSE", "MAE", "RMSE", "MSE"]

# ============================================================
# 2. METRIC FUNCTION
# ==============================================================

def compute_metrics(y_true, y_pred):

    mse = mean_squared_error(y_true, y_pred)
    rmse = np.sqrt(mse)
    mae = mean_absolute_error(y_true, y_pred)
    r2 = r2_score(y_true, y_pred)

    std_obs = np.std(y_true, ddof=1)

    rsr = rmse / std_obs if std_obs != 0 else np.nan

    denominator = np.sum(
        (y_true - np.mean(y_true)) ** 2
    )

    nse = (
        1 - np.sum((y_true - y_pred) ** 2) / denominator
        if denominator != 0 else np.nan
    )

    return {
        "R²": r2,
        "RSR": rsr,
        "NSE": nse,
        "MAE": mae,
        "RMSE": rmse,
        "MSE": mse
    }


# ============================================================
# 3. RECREATE IDENTICAL 5-FOLD SPLITS
# ==============================================================

from sklearn.model_selection import KFold, train_test_split

kf = KFold(
    n_splits=5,
    shuffle=True,
    random_state=SEED
)

peephole_results = []
proposed_results = []

# ============================================================
# 4. RUN BOTH MODELS ON EACH FOLD
# ==============================================================

for fold, (train_idx, test_idx) in enumerate(
    kf.split(X), start=1
):

    print(f"\nProcessing Fold {fold}/5")

    X_fold_train = X[train_idx]
    y_fold_train = y[train_idx]

    X_fold_test = X[test_idx]
    y_fold_test = y[test_idx]

    # Internal validation split
    X_subtrain, X_val_fold, y_subtrain, y_val_fold = \
        train_test_split(
            X_fold_train,
            y_fold_train,
            test_size=0.15,
            random_state=SEED + fold
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # MODEL 1: Peephole LSTM
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    start_1 = time.time()

    encoder_1 = PeepholeLSTMEncoder(
        input_size=1,
        hidden_size=HIDDEN_UNITS,
        dropout=DROPOUT
    )

    trained_1 = train_encoder(
        X_subtrain,
        y_subtrain,
        X_val_fold,
        y_val_fold,
        seed=SEED + fold
    )

    train_emb_1 = extract_embeddings(
        trained_1, X_subtrain
    )

    test_emb_1 = extract_embeddings(
        trained_1, X_fold_test
    )

    # Regression head
    rfr_1 = RandomForestRegressor(
        n_estimators=RF_TREES,
        random_state=SEED + fold,
        n_jobs=-1
    )

    rfr_1.fit(train_emb_1, y_subtrain)

    pred_1 = rfr_1.predict(test_emb_1)

    time_1 = time.time() - start_1

    metrics_1 = compute_metrics(
        y_fold_test, pred_1
    )

    peephole_results.append({
        "Fold": fold,
        **metrics_1,
        "Time": time_1
    })

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # MODEL 2: PeepholeMN-RFR (PROPOSED)
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    start_2 = time.time()

    # Proposed model uses its own independent model initialization
    proposed_encoder = PeepholeLSTMEncoder(
        input_size=1,
        hidden_size=HIDDEN_UNITS,
        dropout=DROPOUT
    )

    trained_proposed = train_encoder(
        X_subtrain,
        y_subtrain,
        X_val_fold,
        y_val_fold,
        seed=SEED + fold
    )

    train_emb_2 = extract_embeddings(
        trained_proposed, X_subtrain
    )

    test_emb_2 = extract_embeddings(
        trained_proposed, X_fold_test
    )

    rfr_2 = RandomForestRegressor(
        n_estimators=RF_TREES,
        random_state=SEED + fold,
        n_jobs=-1
    )

    rfr_2.fit(train_emb_2, y_subtrain)

    pred_2 = rfr_2.predict(test_emb_2)

    time_2 = time.time() - start_2

    metrics_2 = compute_metrics(
        y_fold_test, pred_2
    )

    proposed_results.append({
        "Fold": fold,
        **metrics_2,
        "Time": time_2
    })

    print("Fold completed.")


# ============================================================
# 5. CONVERT RESULTS TO DATAFRAMES
# ==============================================================

peephole_df = pd.DataFrame(peephole_results)
proposed_df = pd.DataFrame(proposed_results)

print("\nPeephole LSTM Results:")
print(peephole_df.round(6))

print("\nPeepholeMN-RFR Results:")
print(proposed_df.round(6))


# ============================================================
# 6. PAIRED T-TEST AND 95% CONFIDENCE INTERVAL
# ==============================================================

statistical_results = []

n = N_FOLDS
df = n - 1

t_critical = t.ppf(0.975, df)

for metric in METRICS:

    # Values for each fold
    baseline_values = peephole_df[metric].values
    proposed_values = proposed_df[metric].values

    # Paired differences: Proposed - Peephole
    differences = proposed_values - baseline_values

    mean_difference = np.mean(differences)

    sd_difference = np.std(
        differences, ddof=1
    )

    se_difference = sd_difference / np.sqrt(n)

    # Paired t-test
    t_statistic, p_value = ttest_rel(
        proposed_values,
        baseline_values
    )

    # 95% confidence interval
    ci_lower = mean_difference - t_critical * se_difference
    ci_upper = mean_difference + t_critical * se_difference

    statistical_results.append({

        "Metrics": metric,

        "Peephole": np.mean(baseline_values),

        "PeepholeMN-RFR": np.mean(proposed_values),

        "Mean Difference": mean_difference,

        "SD of Differences": sd_difference,

        "t-statistic (df=4)": t_statistic,

        "p-value": p_value,

        "95% CI Lower": ci_lower,

        "95% CI Upper": ci_upper

    })


# ============================================================
# 7. FINAL STATISTICAL TABLE
# ==============================================================

stat_df = pd.DataFrame(statistical_results)

# Format confidence interval as one column
stat_df["95% CI of Difference"] = stat_df.apply(
    lambda row: (
        f"[{row['95% CI Lower']:.6f}, "
        f"{row['95% CI Upper']:.6f}]"
    ),
    axis=1
)

final_stat_table = stat_df[
    [
        "Metrics",
        "Peephole",
        "PeepholeMN-RFR",
        "Mean Difference",
        "SD of Differences",
        "t-statistic (df=4)",
        "p-value",
        "95% CI of Difference"
    ]
].round(6)

print("\n" + "=" * 120)
print("PAIRED STATISTICAL SIGNIFICANCE ANALYSIS")
print("=" * 120)

print(final_stat_table.to_string(index=False))


# ============================================================
# 8. SAVE RESULTS
# ==============================================================

stat_path = os.path.join(
    OUTPUT_DIR,
    "Paired_TTest_Statistical_Results.csv"
)

fold_path = os.path.join(
    OUTPUT_DIR,
    "Peephole_vs_Proposed_Foldwise_Results.csv"
)

final_stat_table.to_csv(
    stat_path, index=False
)

combined_fold_df = pd.concat(
    [
        peephole_df.assign(Method="Peephole LSTM"),
        proposed_df.assign(Method="PeepholeMN-RFR")
    ],
    ignore_index=True
)

combined_fold_df.to_csv(
    fold_path, index=False
)

print("\nSaved statistical results:")
print(stat_path)

print("\nSaved fold-wise results:")
print(fold_path)

print("\nPaired statistical analysis completed.")
